'''Synthturf''' was an artificial form of [[Grass/Legends|grass]] that was used in sporting stadiums.

==Behind the scenes==
Synthturf appeared in [[Laurie Burns]]' short story "[[Ringers (short story)|Ringers]]," published in the [[May]] [[1995]] [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 6|sixth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'' magazine.<ref name="Journal6">{{JournalCite|6|Ringers (short story)}}</ref>
